2. Read and parse the category rules from category_rules.txt to understand the categorization logic
3. Load and examine the expenses.xlsx data to understand its structure and current categories
4. Identify miscategorized expenses by applying the category rules to each transaction in the expenses data
5. Create expenses_corrected.xlsx in /workspace with a new 'Correct_Category' column containing the validated categories
6. Generate analysis report by calculating total amount, number of employees, and cost per employee for each category
7. Save the analysis report as workspace/expenses_analysis.csv with the required columns
8. Upload expenses_corrected.xlsx and expenses_analysis.csv to the Documents/Financials/Expenses folder on ownCloud [owncloud]
